title: Broadcast-Band Occupancy by Hour
dataSources: Aircraft messages (`adsb:message`), APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), AIS vessel messages (`ais:message`), rtl_433 decodes (`rtl433:sensor`), RF occupancy summaries (`sdr:spectrum`), satellite observations (`satnogs:observation`), and repeater use (`repeater:activity`).
app: Radio and SDR telemetry from WSPR, APRS, ADS-B, AIS, rtl_433, SatNOGS, and local receiver health feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and log shippers.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sdr:spectrum
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats avg(active_bins) as avg_active_bins by band hour
| sort band hour
description: Measures how occupied each monitored band is through the day based on active frequency bins.
value: Occupancy trends turn waterfall screenshots into something you can compare and learn from over weeks or months.
implementation: Summarize waterfall captures into active-bin counts for each band and send hourly aggregates to Splunk.
visualization: Heat map of average active bins by band and hour.
grandmaExplanation: It logs how crowded each radio band gets at different times of day.
